description: Chicago based production crew Tensei is back with their new single, "Fall in Love" from forthcoming EP featuring soul singer/multi-instrumentalist Khari Lemuel of The Purple Flames. Love has no genre boundaries and Tensei and Khari reflected upon this universal truth by melding several musical styles together. Enjoy the good vibes and never be afraid to fall in love again. Be on the lookout for more music from Tensei including an EP with Khari Lemuel, an LP executive produced by Tensei with Hip Hop artist ADaD, Tensei full length LP and many more in 2016.
